# Lanternfall pixel art. tools/gen_sprites.py turns this into sprites.h.
# '#' black ink, '-' white (opaque), '.' transparent.
# Flags after the size: opaque ('.' is white too), outline (adds a 1 px white halo, sprite grows by 2).
# Short rows are padded with '.'.
